return_basis: 12-month price return excluding dividends; future dividends not assumed
threshold_status: NOT SET: analyst policy requires explicit rationale; no invented institutional thresholds.
date_policy: Retrospective September 30 fair value cannot be compared mechanically with November 6 close as a 12-month target. Revalue at a justified forward horizon; subtract elapsed FCFF from roll-forward EV and reconcile future cash/claims/shares consistently. No automatic (1+WACC) equity-price roll-forward.
